g.text: PROPORTIONAL · LEFT DEFAULT NAV + OPTIONAL CALLER RAIL
H1 IS MINIMUM, NOT A FIXED TRACK. HC SHRINKS AS HEADER WRAPS.
NAVIGATION SLOT INTERNALS ARE OWNED BY THE SIDEBAR COMPONENT.
HEADER IS FLEX-WRAP; ACTIONS MAY WRAP.
OVERFLOW STAYS IN THE CONTENT COLUMN.
PORTALLED CHILDREN JOIN THE BODY FLEX ROW.
EMPTY RAIL HAS NO BOX AND NO RESERVED WIDTH.
INSET VARIANTS ADD S5 AND R1 AT DESKTOP.
FORCED DESKTOP ALSO APPLIES BELOW BP2.
MOBILE NAV DRAWS OVER THE CONTENT.
DEFAULT: FLAT · INSET: THREE SHADOW LAYERS
LIGHT: MAXIMUM NOMINAL EXTENT OF THREE LAYERS.
DEFAULT SHELL HAS NO DROP SHADOW OR SCRIM.
RAIL IS A SIBLING OF SCROLL ROOT, NEVER INSIDE ITS VIEWPORT.
LIFTED LAYERS SHOW DOM OWNERSHIP, NOT CSS Z-INDEX.
SCALE 1:1 FIXED PARTS · HUG AND FLEX WIDTHS SCHEMATIC
HEADERCONTENT ?? TITLE · ACTIONS CONTAINER ALWAYS EXISTS.
SCHEMATIC · VIEWPORT BREAKPOINTS, NOT CONTAINER QUERIES
DEFAULT MOBILE DRAWER: WN = 0 IN FLOW.
NAV OVERLAYS; NON-SPLIT NONE RETAINS WN.
SCALE 2:1 · NO NESTED CHILD RADIUS IS IMPOSED
NO SHELL GRID TRACKS OR BUILT-IN PAGE FOOTER.
HEADER / FOOTER INSIDE NAV BELONG TO SIDEBAR.
INSET SHADOW IS CONDITIONAL; RAIL HAS NO BOX.
